question: Which city is referred to as the ‘Manchester of India’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ahmedabad** is referred to as the 'Manchester of India'.
 
• This nickname was given due to its thriving textile industry, which is similar to the industrial city of Manchester in the United Kingdom.
 
• Ahmedabad has numerous textile mills and is a major center for the production and export of textiles in India.
 
• The city has a rich history in the textile sector, contributing significantly to the economy and providing employment to many.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ahmedabad** is the largest city in the state of Gujarat.
 
• The city has a population of over 5.5 million people and is known for its rich cultural heritage and historical significance.
 
• Ahmedabad is also an important economic and industrial hub, with a diverse range of industries including chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and IT.
 
• The city is home to several prestigious educational institutions and is known for its vibrant culture and festivals.
